en:
A standard camouflage paint scheme for battles in forests
and green areas. It blends into the surroundings
and deceives the enemy's eyes.

Camouflage made of fragments in similar colors.
Normal camouflage blends into forests or deserts, but
splinter camouflage is used to make the machine's outline
harder to make out.

Camouflage with a dot pattern laid out by computer.
Effective in close combat and against night-vision devices.
